name: voicebox
description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
one_liner: Software that clones anyone's voice from a short sample and then reads out anything you type in that voice, running entirely on your own computer with no monthly cloud subscription.
buyer: A podcaster, YouTuber, or online course creator who wants professional narration in their own voice without re-recording every script or paying for an ElevenLabs subscription.
business_use_cases: A content creator generates narration for every new video in their cloned voice instead of re-recording audio each time.
A customer-support team builds a local voice-reply bot for phone/IVR without ever sending customer audio to a third-party cloud service.
An audiobook publisher batch-narrates backlist books in an author's cloned voice at a fraction of studio-recording cost.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for creators who don't want to self-host, billed monthly
Sell pre-made, licensed voice packs for creators who don't have their own clean voice sample

steal_this: Build a browser extension this weekend that reads any webpage aloud in the user's own cloned voice, and sell it as a one-time license.
